long_biography.plain_text:
Anthony Collé entered property through an apprenticeship and a Spanish development introduced by his father, a wine merchant who financed real-estate entrepreneurs. He created a small sales business around that project, then learned brokerage and digital distribution at Piguet, Naef and Swissimo, where he helped launch the portal that became Homegate.

In 2002, Collé joined Maurice Klunge's group and helped develop its agencies into Domicim. He later created Realitim and other collective-investment vehicles before selling MK-Domicim and concentrating on Fundim. The company combines residential development with regulated investment management and has tested ownership models designed to reduce buyers' upfront land costs. Stoneweg acquired a majority stake in Fundim in 2025, but Collé remained board chair and continues to direct its strategy and expansion across Switzerland.
